data.title: 美杜莎 Rider · 暮色图书馆的紫色花嫁
data.description: 【冬木旧图书馆·暮色】美杜莎穿着深紫婚纱坐在高窗旁，极长紫发顺着椅背落下，捧花里夹着一本合上的旧书；她轻轻抚过书脊，摘下眼镜直视镜头，安静表情里有罕见的信任。
data.action: 高窗旁抚过捧花中的旧书并摘下眼镜，紫纱下安静直视镜头
data.promptProse: Medusa sits beside the old library window in a deep-violet bridal gown, long purple hair pooling over the chair. She touches the closed book among her bouquet flowers, then removes her glasses to offer a trusting look beneath the translucent veil. The vertical medium-full view includes silver trim and book-shaped charm against tall shelves. Violet twilight crosses the veil and shelf edges, leaving the bouquet's nested pages in gentle shade.
